snippet.title: Don't ever quit. My story.
snippet.description:
In college I dreamed about working on Wall Street.
I tried everything.
Internships. Interviews.
Even tried starting a small fund.
None of it worked.
After graduation, during COVID,
I was living on a friend’s couch.
Out of boredom I started making finance videos on YouTube. 🎥
At first they were terrible.
Years later those videos opened doors I never expected.
Business opportunities.
Meeting incredible people.
Eventually even making enough money to launch my own finance company.
A full circle moment. 🔄
